title: fix(send): warn on terminal --task state and fail non-zero on silent no-op
description: a2a send --task <completed-id> printed INITIALIZING... and exited in 0.49s with code 0 (Friction A3). Perform pre-flight GetTask check. If task is terminal, warn on stderr naming state and suggesting --context. In --strict mode, fail fast with exit code 1.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Default mode outputs warning to stderr: 'Warning: task <id> is in terminal state TASK_STATE_COMPLETED. Use --context <ctx> for multi-turn conversations.' 2) --strict mode aborts with exit code 1 and ErrCodeFailedPrecondition.

title: fix(cli): propagate streaming errors and fail non-zero on empty streams
description: TUI streaming errors and zero-event streams exited cleanly with code 0 (Friction C1, C2). Refactor streaming renderers to return streamSummary and error. Ensure runTUI propagates m.err and non-zero exit codes. Detect zero-event streams and raise ErrCodeFailedPrecondition.
acceptance_criteria: 1) TUI model errors cause exit code 1 and stderr output. 2) Streams with 0 events raise explicit error rather than silent exit 0.

title: feat(send): add --context flag to continue conversations
description: Evaluator was unable to continue multi-turn conversations across send invocations (Friction A1). Add a persistent --context flag to a2acli send allowing users to specify a ContextID for multi-turn conversations. Plumb msg.ContextID into a2a.Message in multimodal.go.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Running 'a2acli send --context <ctx> "msg"' sets msg.ContextID = <ctx>. 2) Passing --context is reflected in verbose logs and passed to service. 3) Documented in help text and manuals.

title: feat(output): surface Task ID and Context ID across all output modes
description: contextId was omitted from stdout; evaluator patched Python server to discover it (Friction A2, D2). Update tui.go, runText, and displayTaskResult to capture and display both Task ID and Context ID. Output standardized continuation footer in non-JSON modes.
acceptance_criteria: 1) TUI status bar displays 'Task: <id> | Context: <ctx>'. 2) Text, --wait, and --immediate modes print standardized summary footer with 'Task ID:', 'Context ID:', and 'Continue: a2acli send --context <ctx> "msg"'.

title: test(e2e): add journey and continuity suites with make test-journey
description: Automate Tier 0 journey test cases into e2e/conformance_test.go as TestJourneySuites, and add make test-journey Makefile target.
acceptance_criteria: 1) make test-journey executes suites TP-2.1, TP-3.1, TP-3.2, TP-4.1, TP-4.2, TP-4.3, TP-5.1, TP-7.1 and passes cleanly.

title: fix(version): fallback to runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo for go install builds
description: a2a --version printed version dev / commit: none / built at: unknown when installed via go install (Friction E1). Implement runtime/debug.ReadBuildInfo() fallback in version.go when build variables are unset or equal to dev/none/unknown.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Binaries installed via go install print actual module version (e.g. v1.9.0) and VCS revision rather than dev / none / unknown.

title: fix(list): add CONTEXT ID column and format status column
description: a2a list tasks table truncated status column and omitted CONTEXT ID (Friction A5, D4). Follow-on to closed bead a2ac-mvu. Add CONTEXT ID column to output table. Strip TASK_STATE_ prefix from STATUS column values (COMPLETED, WORKING) and fix column alignment.
acceptance_criteria: 1) a2a list tasks displays columns: TASK ID, CONTEXT ID, STATUS, CREATED AT. 2) STATUS formatted as COMPLETED, WORKING, etc. 3) Headers align properly without overflow.

title: docs(send): clarify --ref artifact referencing vs conversation continuation in A2A 1.0
description: Evaluator assumed --ref was a conversation continuation flag (Friction A4). Update help text and manuals for --ref to clarify that --ref (ReferenceTasks) is a first-class A2A Protocol 1.0 feature for referencing completed task artifacts, whereas --context (ContextID) must be used for thread continuation.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Help text explicitly distinguishes --task (active task), --context (conversation group), and --ref (artifact reference). 2) Continuation footers remove reference to --ref as a conversation continuation mechanism.

title: feat(discover): accept positional URL on discover and validate zero-arg commands
description: a2a discover http://127.0.0.1:9999 silently swallowed positional URL and queried default 127.0.0.1:9001 (Friction B1, B2). Allow a2acli discover <url> as an ergonomics alias for -u <url>. Enforce cobra.NoArgs on zero-arg commands.
acceptance_criteria: 1) a2a discover http://127.0.0.1:9999 correctly targets specified URL. 2) Extra args on version, serve, conformance, list tasks, config, auth raise unexpected argument error. 3) Connection errors hint --service-url / -u.

title: refactor(flags)!: swap -o to --output and move --out-dir to -d
description: Running a2a send ... -o JSON created a local directory named JSON/ instead of outputting JSON (Friction B3). Rebind -o shorthand to --output (tui/text/json), and move --out-dir shorthand to -d. Add directory guard to reject -d json or --out-dir text with helpful error.
acceptance_criteria: 1) a2a send "hello" -o json outputs NDJSON. 2) a2a send "hello" -d ./artifacts saves artifacts. 3) Passing -d json or --out-dir text raises error: 'invalid directory name "json": did you mean --output json?'.

title: Friction log triage — a2acli v1.9.0 (@sampathm, Aug 2026)
description: Epic tracking all remediation items from the friction log evaluation of a2acli v1.9.0 (@sampathm, Aug 2026). Covers conversation continuity, argument validation, exit codes, and output formatting. See ../friction-reports/a2acli-friction-triage.md and ../friction-reports/a2acli-test-plan.md.

title: Assign stable machine-readable check IDs to a2acli conformance smoke checks
description: Refactor cmd/a2acli/conformance.go to assign stable IDs matching A2A-CARD-*, A2A-OPS-*, A2A-SEC-* from the conformance skill checklist, and deduplicate the result struct against internal/conformance.Result.

title: Implement serve --proxy <url> zero-code A2A exposure mode
description: Implement the declared serve --proxy flag to allow wrapping an existing HTTP/REST service as an A2A agent without writing code.

title: docs: port journey test plan into a2acli/docs/TEST_PLAN.md
description: Port the comprehensive friction test plan into a2acli/docs/TEST_PLAN.md as an official repository documentation artifact.
acceptance_criteria: 1) docs/TEST_PLAN.md exists and contains suites TP-1 through TP-7.

title: chore(output): move "Auto-selected transport" output banner behind --verbose
description: Auto-selected transport: JSONRPC was printed to stdout before TUI initialization on every command (Friction D3). Suppress transport selection banner during TUI execution unless --verbose / -v is enabled.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Standard send invocations do not print transport selection text to stdout prior to TUI. 2) --verbose continues to output transport selection details.

title: feat(output): add optional --output compact block format
description: Evaluator preferred the legacy SDK's compact structured block format over streaming TUI (Friction D1). Add --output compact output mode providing a structured, single-frame block format (Task, Context, Status, Artifacts, History) matching legacy SDK output styling.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Running 'a2acli send --output compact "msg"' renders a clean summary block without animation.

title: fix(discover): remove client-side auth pre-flight on --extended card resolution
description: a2a discover --extended errored client-side before sending RPC when local credentials were absent (Friction C3). Remove client-side credential pre-flight in fetchExtendedCard. Attempt GetExtendedAgentCard RPC unconditionally and emit auth hints only on 401/403 status.
acceptance_criteria: 1) a2a discover --extended executes against unauthenticated test servers without requiring local token configuration. 2) 401/403 responses output auth login hint.

title: Implement serve --exec <cmd> CLI wrapper exposure mode
description: Implement serve --exec flag to expose local CLI commands as streaming A2A agent tasks.

title: Implement push notification webhook receiver in a2acli serve
description: Add a webhook receiver endpoint to a2acli serve to enable end-to-end testing of A2A push notification delivery.

title: Display Agent Version in 'describe' command
description: The Agent Card schema includes a 'Version' field (e.g., '0.9.0' for GenUI alignment), but the a2acli currently does not display this version information when discovering or describing an agent. We should update the 'describe' command (and any other relevant output) to surface the AgentCard.Version field to the user.
close_reason: Added Version to describe command output

title: Ensure full coverage of global flags (--auth, --svc-param, etc.)
description: The official a2a CLI has some developer-focused global flags like '--auth' (shorthand for authorization headers) and repeatable '--svc-param' arrays. We should review a2acli's flags and add these to ensure full feature parity for protocol testing. See reference: github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/v2/cmd/a2a/main.go

title: Add 'list' command (specifically 'list tasks')
description: The official a2a CLI supports an 'a2a list tasks' command which queries the server for previous task artifacts or logs if the server supports history. We should implement a similar resource listing capability. See reference: github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/v2/cmd/a2a/list.go and tasks.go

title: Add 'serve' command for mock/proxy/exec agents
description: The official a2a CLI supports an 'a2a serve' command to quickly spin up A2A-compliant mock agents (--echo), proxies (--proxy), and shell wrappers (--exec). We should implement this capability to help developers easily test a2acli against local mock servers without writing full Go backends. See reference: github.com/a2aproject/a2a-go/v2/cmd/a2a/serve.go

title: Epic: Feature parity with official a2a CLI
description: The official a2a CLI has some developer/protocol features that are missing in a2acli. We should evaluate and add them to make a2acli a complete superset. Features include: 1) a serve command for mocking, 2) resource listing (e.g. list tasks), and 3) full coverage of global flags like --auth and --svc-param.

title: fix(build): resolve A2A_SIMPLE_SRC default path in Makefile
description: make test-e2e fails when ../../a2a-simple is absent because the repo is named a2a-experiments. Update A2A_SIMPLE_SRC default path in Makefile to fallback gracefully when ../../a2a-simple is absent, checking /workspace/a2a-experiments.
acceptance_criteria: 1) make test-e2e locates a2a-experiments automatically if a2a-simple directory is missing.

title: docs(install): add GOPATH/bin PATH setup and alias guidance
description: Evaluator had trouble locating binary after go install, requiring ls ~/go/bin and setting alias a2a=... (Friction E2). Update README.md go install section with instructions for adding /Users/ghchinoy/go/bin to PATH, and suggest alias a2a=a2acli shorthand.
acceptance_criteria: 1) README.md includes explicit shell export examples for GOPATH/bin and shell alias configuration.

title: Support inline image rendering via Kitty protocol
description: The A2UI server (and other agents) may return images in their responses or UI payloads. We should investigate adding support for the Kitty image protocol (or a similar terminal image rendering protocol) so that 'a2acli' can display images directly in the TUI when supported by the user's terminal emulator.
